scene: RT测试 world (E:/Minecraft/26.2), two purpose-built sealed white-concrete rooms on the empty NW grassland. Daylight frozen at 6000, weather clear, camera static per scene.
renderer: Vulkan (NVIDIA 616.92), DLSS-RR 1280x720 -> 2560x1440 preset 6, max-fps uncapped to 250 for the sweep (user setting 10 restored after), vsync off

config.time: 6000 pinned (daylight cycle already frozen in the save)

camera.opaque: (-43.7,-58,-43.7) yaw -45 pitch 10, interior corner of the diffuse room; shell x[-45,-31] y[-59,-52] z[-45,-31], three 1x1 ceiling holes on the diagonal
camera.glass: (-25.5,-58,-43.5) yaw -45 pitch 15; shell x[-27,-13] same y/z band, 7x9 glass ceiling strip, 7x7 source-water pool (water[level=0]) in a concrete rim, two 1x1 holes; the complex's tall orange/white building is visible through the glass (static geometry)

protocol: 10 arms per scene: bounces 2,3,4,5,6,8 sweep + default 4 interleaved after every arm as in-session reference; each arm = UI slider set (live push-constant, no restart), 2.5 s settle, 10 s quiet sampling window bracketed by gpu.csv tail reads, then a 5 s mc_perf snapshot taken OUTSIDE the sampling window (mc_perf stalls GPU query readback and collapses the timed-frame rate - first protocol revision).
noise_floor: ref-4 arms repeated 5x per scene; drift of their medians vs the pooled ref median <= 0.052 ms (traceIndirect), <= 0.006 ms (tracePrimary) - two orders of magnitude below the marginals
findings: No 3->4 strategy discontinuity: the 2->3 marginal (+4.51/+4.46 ms) and the 3->4 marginal (+4.49/+4.61 ms) are equal within noise, in both scenes. rrStart moving 1->2 at maxBounces=4 (indirect.rgen.slang:79) does not show up as a frame-cost avalanche.
Marginal cost per bounce DECLINES with depth (opaque: 4.51, 4.49, 2.93, 2.33, ~1.42/bounce for 6->8): Russian roulette plus throughput decay already prune deep paths efficiently.

The glass/water scene costs the same as the opaque diffuse scene at every bounce level (medians within ~0.15 ms of each other): dielectric continuation and specular chains are not a meaningful per-bounce cost driver at this scene scale.

tracePrimaryMs is flat (~1.0 ms) across all bounce levels in both scenes: the transmission-guide crossing loop (guides.slang uses worldPush.maxBounces) does not make the primary pass scale with bounces here.
Even B=2 carries a 13.5 ms traceIndirect baseline at 1280x720 traced; B=4 default adds +9.0 ms over B=2, B=8 adds +8.1 ms over B=4 (total pass medians 35.1 -> 43.1 ms).
notes: max-fps was raised 10 -> 250 for the sweep (GPU-bound 99%) and restored to the user's 10 afterwards in options.txt.
mc_perf must not be called inside the sampling window: it stalls GPU query readback and collapses the timed-frame rate (protocol revision after the first attempt).

The two rooms were built for this sweep on empty NW grassland; the README-shaft-preview coordinates (y 149-157 box) do not exist in this save - the world's structures sit at negative Y (ground ~y-70).
